verdict.rationale: kitty is a local GPU-based terminal emulator with no hosted service, account data, or production environment, so a sandbox separate from production data is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows kitty shipping any sandbox or test-environment capability that would make the axis apply. Its remote-control scripting and SSH features are unrelated and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
